title: The No-Nonsense Guide to How to Sell Ebooks from Kenya

excerpt: Selling digital products from Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, or Zimbabwe is fully operational with sovereign commerce infrastructure that has no geographic restrictions.

content.text: As a digital creator in Ghana, you're likely no stranger to the woes of online payment processing. Platforms like Stripe and PayPal are notoriously finicky, often freezing accounts or rejecting transactions without explanation. But what happens when you need to sell ebooks and can't rely on these platforms? You're forced to navigate a complex web of workarounds, or worse, abandon your business altogether. This guide is for creators who refuse to be held back by these infrastructure limitations. We'll show you how to build a sovereign commerce infrastructure that lets you sell ebooks with confidence, using the tools that put you in control.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

This infrastructure is built to succeed where platforms fail. By leveraging open-source tools and blockchain-based payments, you can avoid the pitfalls of traditional payment processing. With a sovereign commerce stack, you own the entire payment and delivery pipeline, from order storage to file delivery. This means you're not beholden to any third-party platform, and you can process transactions with complete confidence. Whether you're selling ebooks, courses, or software, this infrastructure gives you the freedom to focus on what matters most: creating value for your customers.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy your sovereign commerce infrastructure, you'll need a few key pieces of setup. First, create a GitHub account to host your store's front-end. Next, set up a Supabase or Google Sheets instance to store your orders. You'll also need a Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account to deliver your ebooks. Finally, obtain a NOWPayments account to enable blockchain-based payments. With these tools in place, you're ready to deploy your sovereign commerce stack and start selling ebooks with confidence.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline is a straightforward process. First, create a new Cloudflare Pages site to host your store's front-end. Next, deploy your Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers backend to handle payment processing and order storage. Finally, integrate your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account to deliver your ebooks to customers. With these pieces in place, you'll be able to process transactions and deliver products to customers with ease.
With sovereign commerce infrastructure, you're not beholden to any third-party platform.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Going live with your sovereign commerce infrastructure is a breeze. Simply deploy your Cloudflare Pages site, update your NOWPayments account settings, and start selling ebooks. When a customer makes a purchase, the NOWPayments webhook will automatically fire, processing the transaction and sending the customer their ebook. With this infrastructure, you can rest assured that every transaction is secure, reliable, and easily scalable.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Scaling your sovereign commerce infrastructure is a matter of adding more resources to your existing setup. As your store grows, simply upgrade your Cloudflare Pages plan, add more instances to your Supabase or Google Sheets setup, and increase your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 storage. With this infrastructure, you can scale with confidence, knowing that every transaction is secure and reliable.
